name: Boost Note
description: Sets verifyUpdateCodeSignature:false on Windows, disabling Authenticode publisher check; then trusts only a SHA512 from the same GitHub endpoint — endpoint compromise ⇒ RCE. Unmaintained.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The reviewed Boost Note main process uses electron-gh-releases against the BoostIO/boost-releases repository, checks periodically when packaged, downloads after confirmation, and installs after the download event. This snapshot does not substantiate the claimed verifyUpdateCodeSignature:false or a Boost Note-local SHA512 verification policy; dependency and released-artifact verification remain unresolved.

fields.label: repo
fields.value: BoostIO/Boostnote ("BoostNote-Legacy" — the classic desktop app; update feed points at BoostIO/boost-releases). Superseded by BoostIO/BoostNote-App, not analyzed here.

fields.label: framework
fields.value: Electron, `electron-gh-releases` v2 wrapping Electron's **built-in native `autoUpdater`** (Squirrel.Mac / Squirrel.Windows)

fields.label: has_updater
fields.value: Y (macOS + Windows only; disabled on Linux)

fields.label: auto
fields.value: auto-check (daily interval + 10s after launch, plus manual trigger) → renderer notified → user must click to confirm download (`update-download-confirm` IPC) → user must click to confirm install (`update-app-confirm` IPC)

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS — `github.com` API (latest release tag) + `raw.githubusercontent.com` (`auto_updater.json` manifest, macOS) or `github.com/…/releases/download/…` directly (Windows), via the `got` HTTP client (default TLS verification, no insecure-skip found)

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N — `auto_updater.json` is a plain unsigned JSON pointer file; Windows Squirrel `RELEASES` manifest carries SHA1 hashes but no cryptographic signature

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: OS-code-signing (macOS: Squirrel.Mac requires the downloaded update's code-signing identity to match the running app before installing) / hash-from-manifest (Windows: Squirrel.Windows checks the package against the SHA1 hash in the `RELEASES` file; no code-signature enforcement by default)

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: macOS: the app's Developer ID code-signing certificate, enforced by the OS (`codesign`/Gatekeeper), not app-controlled; Windows: none — SHA1 hash comparison only, no cryptographic key

fields.label: evidence
fields.value: lib/main-app.js:5,31-36 (`GhReleases({repo:'BoostIO/boost-releases', ...})`); lib/main-app.js:40-96 (daily/startup `checkUpdate`, manual IPC gates `update-download-confirm`/`update-app-confirm`); electron-gh-releases (jenslind/electron-gh-releases) src/GhReleases.js:1-2,28-38,57-100,105-154 (wraps `require('electron').autoUpdater`; `setFeedURL` to `auto_updater.json` on mac, direct releases/download folder on Windows; `download()`→`checkForUpdates()`, `install()`→`quitAndInstall()`)
